coll: substitute A for B — 用 A 取代 B(新的在前、舊的在後)
substitute for someone — 代替某人、代班
there is no substitute for ~ — …是無可取代的

ex.en: The café has run out of oat milk, so soy milk will be offered as a substitute.
ex.zh: 咖啡館的燕麥奶用完了,將以豆漿替代。

ex.en: The recipe suggests substituting olive oil for butter.
ex.zh: 食譜建議用橄欖油取代奶油。

ex.en: Mr. Alvarez will substitute for Ms. Kim while she is on leave.
ex.zh: Kim 女士休假期間將由 Alvarez 先生代理。

pos: n. 代替品、代理人、代課老師
v. 用…代替(substitute A for B)
v. 代打、頂替(substitute for someone)
root: sub-(在下面、接替)+ stitute(站立,拉丁 statuere)—— 站到原本那個位子去頂替。同家族:institute、constitute。
tip: substitute 後面先講新的、replace 後面先講舊的,順序剛好相反。
zh: 代替品、代班;代替(A for B)
